nodes.label: Transformer
nodes.description: A new simple network architecture based solely on attention mechanisms

nodes.label: Attention mechanism
nodes.description: A key component of the Transformer model, allowing for parallelization and efficient processing of sequential data

nodes.label: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs)
nodes.description: A type of neural network designed to handle sequential data, such as time series or natural language.

nodes.label: Long short-term memory (LSTM)
nodes.description: A variant of RNNs that can learn long-term dependencies in sequential data.

nodes.label: Gated recurrent neural networks (GRNs)
nodes.description: Another type of RNN

nodes.label: Encoder-decoder architecture
nodes.description: A common approach in sequence transduction models

nodes.label: Self-attention
nodes.description: An attention mechanism relating different positions of a single sequence to compute a representation.

nodes.label: Multi-head attention
nodes.description: An extension of Scaled Dot-Product Attention that uses multiple attention heads to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces.

nodes.label: Position representation
nodes.description: A parameter-free representation used in multi-head attention

nodes.label: Recurrent Models
nodes.description: Models that factor computation along symbol positions of input and output sequences.

nodes.label: Transformer Model
nodes.description: A model architecture relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output.

nodes.label: ConvS2S
nodes.description: A model using convolutional neural networks as basic building block, computing hidden representations in parallel for all input and output positions.

nodes.label: ByteNet
nodes.description: A model using convolutional neural networks as basic building block, computing hidden representations in parallel for all input and output positions with logarithmic complexity.

nodes.label: Extended Neural GPU
nodes.description: A model using convolutional neural networks as basic building block, computing hidden representations in parallel for all input and output positions.

nodes.label: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs)
nodes.description: Basic building blocks for computing hidden representations in parallel.

nodes.label: Recurrent Attention Mechanism
nodes.description: An attention mechanism used in end-to-end memory networks instead of sequence-aligned recurrence.

nodes.label: Transformer Architecture
nodes.description: A stacked self-attention mechanism and fully connected layers for both encoder and decoder.

nodes.label: Self-Attention Mechanism
nodes.description: A multi-head attention mechanism that maps a query and key-value pairs to an output.

nodes.label: Residual Connection
nodes.description: A connection around each sub-layer, followed by layer normalization.

nodes.label: Layer Normalization
nodes.description: A technique to normalize the output of each sub-layer.

nodes.label: Scaled Dot-Product Attention
nodes.description: A particular attention mechanism that computes the dot products of query with all keys, divide each by √dk, and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values.

nodes.label: Additive Attention
nodes.description: A type of attention mechanism that computes compatibility using a feed-forward network with a single hidden layer.

nodes.label: Attention
nodes.description: A mechanism for jointly attending to information from different representation subspaces at different positions.

nodes.label: Encoder-Decoder Attention
nodes.description: A mechanism that allows every position in the decoder to attend over all positions in the input sequence.

nodes.label: Position-wise Feed-Forward Networks
nodes.description: Fully connected feed-forward networks applied to each position separately and identically, consisting of two linear transformations with a ReLU activation in between.

nodes.label: Embeddings and Softmax
nodes.description: Learned embeddings used to convert input tokens and output tokens to vectors, followed by a learned linear transformation and softmax function.

nodes.label: Positional Encoding
nodes.description: Adding information about the relative or absolute position of tokens in the sequence to enable the model to make use of the order of the sequence.

nodes.label: Recurrent
nodes.description: A type of layer that uses feedback connections to maintain state over time

nodes.label: Convolutional
nodes.description: A mathematical operation used for feature extraction and filtering.

nodes.label: path length
nodes.description: the third is the path length between long-range dependencies in the network

nodes.label: long-range dependencies
nodes.description: Learning long-range dependencies is a key challenge in many sequence transduction tasks

nodes.label: self-attention layer
nodes.description: A self-attention layer connects all positions with a constant number of sequentially executed operations

nodes.label: recurrent layer
nodes.description: Commonly used in encoder-decoder architectures before the Transformer

nodes.label: computational complexity
nodes.description: In terms of computational complexity, self-attention layers are faster than recurrent layers when the sequence length n is smaller than the representation dimensionality d

nodes.label: neighborhood size
nodes.description: To improve computational performance for tasks involving very long sequences, self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size r in the input sequence centered around the respective output position

nodes.label: convolutional layer
nodes.description: A single convolutional layer with kernel width k < n does not connect all pairs of input and output positions

nodes.label: Feed-Forward Layer
nodes.description: A type of neural network layer that transforms input data.

nodes.label: Point-Wise Feed-Forward Layer
nodes.description: A specific type of feed-forward layer used in self-attention models.

nodes.label: Byte-Pair Encoding
nodes.description: A method for encoding text data into numerical representations.

nodes.label: Word-Piece Vocabulary
nodes.description: A vocabulary of words used for tokenization and encoding in NLP tasks.

nodes.label: Warmup Steps
nodes.description: Linearly decreases for the first training steps and proportionally thereafter.

nodes.label: Regularization
nodes.description: Employed during training to prevent overfitting.

nodes.label: Dropout
nodes.description: Applies dropout to output of each sub-layer and sums of embeddings and positional encodings.

nodes.label: Label Smoothing
nodes.description: Harms perplexity but improves accuracy and BLEU score.

nodes.label: Dropout rate
nodes.description: A regularization technique used to prevent overfitting in neural networks

nodes.label: Beam search
nodes.description: A method for generating multiple possible sequences from a given input, used in the Transformer model

nodes.label: Hyperparameter tuning
nodes.description: The process of adjusting model parameters to optimize performance on a specific task

nodes.label: Multi-headed self-attention
nodes.description: A variant of the attention mechanism used in the Transformer

nodes.label: Local attention mechanisms
nodes.description: A proposed extension to the Transformer model, enabling efficient handling of large inputs and outputs

nodes.label: Sequence generation
nodes.description: A research goal, aiming to make generation less sequential

nodes.label: Neural machine translation
nodes.description: The task of translating human language to machine language

nodes.label: Gradient Flow
nodes.description: The process by which gradients are propagated backwards through a neural network during training.

nodes.label: Neural GPUs
nodes.description: A type of hardware designed to accelerate the training of deep neural networks.

nodes.label: Mixture-of-Experts layer
nodes.description: A sparsely-gated neural network architecture

nodes.label: Sequence to sequence learning
nodes.description: A type of neural network for sequential data

nodes.label: Inception architecture
nodes.description: A deep neural network architecture for computer vision
